text:
Priya (CS): Morning — quick health triage for Unbounce account. Error rate ticked up this week, need a short list of top failing endpoints and likely causes.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] 2025-12-03T09:12:10Z Unbounce - error-rate spike detected: 5xx + timeouts across /v1/generate and /v1/embed. See snapshot: https://infra.redwood/alerts/8492 :rotating_light:

Sam (ProdOps): Numbers from the last 7 days:
- Overall 5xx rate: 2.3% (baseline 0.6%)
- Timeouts (>3s): 1.9% (4x baseline)
- Rate-limits (429): 0.8% (map to spikes in short bursts)

Top failing endpoints (7d, ordered):
1) /v1/generate - 5xx: 6.2k, timeouts: 3.4k
2) /v1/embed - 5xx: 1.1k, timeouts: 420
3) /v1/chat/stream - 5xx: 430, timeouts: 980
4) /health/check - 5xx: 210 (mostly internal auth drops)

Ben (Backend): Quick note — we pushed the token-cache change on 190511 at 22:30 UTC. Seeing increased cache miss ratio on long sequences. Suspect KV cache eviction plus higher concurrency -> backend "OOM retry" path producing 5xx.

Priya (CS): @Ben can you confirm if the deploy correlates to the first jump at 190511 23:00? Customer noticed latency spike during onboarding test runs.

Ben (Backend): Confirmed correlation in traces. Repro steps:
```
POST /v1/generate
payload size ~ 1500 tokens
concurrent ~ 80
```
Cache misses + synchronous disk fallback -> timeouts.

Sam (ProdOps): Short mitigations:
- Rollback token-cache tweak on dedicated pool for Unbounce (can do now).
- Increase concurrency cap for that account (temporary burst) and route large seqs to dedup model variant.
- Set autoscale policy to add a GPU when queue depth > 200 for 2min.

Alex (Acct Owner): Customer is in final onboarding and is sensitive to this. Can we target <1% error for them while they run onboarding flows? Need ETA for rollback/patch.

Ben (Backend): I can rollback the token-cache change for their dedicated slice in ~20m. Patch for async disk fallback will take ~1 business day.

Priya (CS): Please proceed with rollback. Sam, can you enable burst and the autoscale tweak for the next 6 hours? I'll notify the customer and offer a focused session.

Sam (ProdOps): On it. Enabling burst now, ETA 10m. :gear:

oncall-bot: Action logged: rollback requested (ticket #CS-5641), autoscale policy update requested (#OPS-2034).

Priya (CS): Thanks — I'll send a quick note to the customer and schedule a 30-min enablement call. Will follow up here once rollback is complete. :white_check_mark:

Ben (Backend): Rollback complete for Unbounce slice at 1905120060. Monitoring.

Sam (ProdOps): Seeing immediate drop in timeouts on /v1/generate. 5xx trend trending down. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

Alex (Acct Owner): Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please add me to the postmortem and include any recommended config for long-sequence workloads.

Priya (CS): Will do. I'll capture triage notes and next-step enablement items (batching guidelines, quantization suggestion, recommended concurrency). Closing this thread after the postmortem doc.
